comment: Independent re-check run 22 Oct 2026 with the engine's own deterministic checks (grounding.unsupported_terms / ungrounded_numbers) on the 37 PubMed-based items in the reports of 7, 14, 21 and 26 September 2026, and openFDA for the one FDA item. The public About page may say that a review found 'statements that the source does not make' and 'one incorrect date' only while this evidence shows it.

numbersNotLiterallyInTheAbstract.note: paraphrases or derived totals (for example 72 = 36 + 36); the earlier hand audit found no wrong number, so the public text does not claim wrong numbers

fdaItem.note: The FDA 510(k) database page and the openFDA API agree. Only the 2026-09-07 report's item states a wrong date; the launch edition and the Levo treatment record say 'August'.

quietReports.comment: From engine/audit-log.jsonl: at each of these runs no item was evaluated and the listed number of collected items were waiting unassessed, yet the report published 'No evidence-changing tinnitus research identified in this week's scan'.

reviewFlagRule: Union of (a) the 10 PubMed items the engine's unsupported-term check flagged on 22 Oct 2026 and (b) the 10 hand-audit items of 21 Oct 2026 that carry a statement the abstract does not make (the hand audit's item 1 is not caught by the engine); 11 distinct items. reviewFlagsStatus: All 11 interim review flags were removed on 22 Oct 2026: 10 resolved by corrections and 1 (42710361, donepezil) withdrawn with a documented justification. See data/corrections-log.json (flags.resolution).
